line.en: the sunday flea market in la lagunilla, a long strip of stalls for collectors: old records, tools and prints. go in the morning.
line.de: der sonntagsflohmarkt in la lagunilla, eine lange reihe von ständen für sammler: alte platten, werkzeug und drucke. am besten vormittags.
line.tr: la lagunilla'daki pazar günü pazarı; koleksiyoncular için uzun bir stand sırası: eski plaklar, aletler ve baskılar. sabah gidin.

sparks.why: Tianguis de la Lagunilla, a Sunday market listed in Culture Trip and City-Tour guides; no closure notice found for 15 nov 2026.
